dog.description_text: Your fall will be great with Tootsie in it! Tootsie is a beautiful dog who is ready to settle into a home of her own. She enjoys meeting people, leans into petting, and has done well with handling while she's been at the Adoption Center. Tootsie is often waiting at the front of her kennel, eager for her next walk or adventure. She walks nicely on a harness and enjoys getting out to explore the world one sniff at a time. Tootsie likes dogs as much as she likes people! She has played well with other dogs, happily joining in for games before taking breaks to mingle, and she can calmly pass dogs on walks. She will enjoy settling into a predictable routine. A quiet space to relax, regular exercise, and fun enrichment activities will help her thrive! Tootsie can’t wait to feel at home! To learn more about Tootsie, click the “Adopt me” button. *You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
